name: cua-hard/january-new-hire-records
description: Finalise the January 2027 new-hire cohort for a startup's People Ops: work out each starter's agreed title, start date and salary when the recruiter's Slack notes, the Greenhouse offer form, the generated offer-letter PDFs and the DocuSign envelopes disagree; create the BambooHR records, move the applications to Hired in Greenhouse, reply to the recruiter's Slack thread with the mismatches and write a cohort CSV.
